description: Ethereum account state from our own node: ETH balance, nonce, and whether the address is a contract. When to use: balance and account type before sizing a transfer, or telling an EOA from a contract. Do not use: for ERC-20 token balances (eth_read_contract with balanceOf) or address risk scoring. Returns: address, balance_eth, nonce, is_contract, code_size_bytes.
name: eth_get_account
